overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Small Cap Growth ETF (AESG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund actively invests in equity securities of small-cap growth companies, identified through proprietary growth factor analysis. The portfolio will typically hold between 75 and 200 US stocks. AESG was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AESG is an equity ETF with a total of 188 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple Hospitality REIT stock at 2.69%, LiveRamp Holdings at 2.57%, Bread Financial Holdings at 2.51%, First BanCorp. at 2.46%, and Protagonist Therapeutics at 1.68%.
